poc_summary: Workload mix during 6-week trial: 60% chat (avg prompt 350 tokens), 30% embeddings (avg 512 tokens, batched), 10% reranking (short prompts, high QPS).
Observed peak QPS on Hosted during product release simulation: 48 QPS sustained for 20 minutes; burst to 120 QPS for 90s with graceful degradation via autoscaling.
Concurrency footprint: typical concurrency per instance ~12-18 for chat; production target concurrency target ~60 across route for 95th latency SLO.
Token mix: 65% input tokens (user prompts + context), 35% generated tokens; average response length 180 tokens for chat flows used in POC.
Cost sensitivity: finance modeled annual token spend at current traffic ~ $85k/year on Hosted — looking to reduce this with Dedicated (target 40-60% reduction).
traffic_forecast: Baseline daily active users (DAU) for product: 5k; target growth to 12k DAU within 12 months post-launch.
Expected QPS profile post-launch: baseline 20 QPS, normal day 60 QPS, peak campaign spikes up to 220 QPS sustained for 5-10 minutes per spike (estimated 4 spikes/day during launches).
Monthly token volume forecast (12 months): start 120M tokens/month -> 360M tokens/month at scale; embeddings request share to grow from 30% to 45%.
Concurrency planning: aim for 200 concurrent chat streams across cluster to keep 95th pct latency <300ms for chat SLA.
dedicated_capacity_recommendation: Recommendation: initial Dedicated pool = 4 x L40s-equivalent (or 8 x A10/6GB-equivalent mixed) depending on customer preference for fp16 vs int8 quantized runs.
Justification: meets forecasted baseline throughput (60 QPS steady) with headroom for 2x burst handling via autoscale and pre-warmed cache for hot prefixes.
Autoscale policy: target CPU/GPU utilization 60-70% with bleedover capacity to add 1-2 nodes when sustained QPS >100 for >3 minutes.
Failover plan: route to cheaper compatible model variant during extended peak; maintain prefix KV cache to limit quality impact.
pricing_concerns: Customer wants a clear mapping between committed GPU nodes and token-based pricing to show finance predictable unit economics.
Request for 12-month committed capacity discount and rollover credits for unused GPU hours.
Clarify overage billing cadence and min-billing increments for Dedicated nodes.
